title: Shesha-khanda, part 6 (portion 51)
html:
The section "The Lord's Return to Nilachala" (ch. 3): mercy to the cowherd; the Lord at Kulia and Navadvipa — Shachi's lament and the Lord's instruction; kirtana at Advaita's house in Shantipura; by way of Tamoluk to Puri; mercy to King Prataparudra: the sannyasi in Jagannatha's place, the six-armed form, the instruction to the king

The Lord's Return to Nilachala

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. Having seen the places of Sri Krishna's lilas in the Mathura-mandala, Sriman Mahaprabhu wished to return to Nilachala. On the way He walked so fast that His companions could not keep up with Him and fell behind. The Lord was going alone along a forest path; meeting a cowherd boy on the way, He asked him for some buttermilk and, telling him to take the price of the buttermilk from the people coming behind, set off again. A little later the companions arrived there; the cowherd boy told them how the Lord had drunk the buttermilk and asked for payment — but the very next moment he saw that his pot was full of priceless treasure. Thus Sriman Mahaprabhu, as if for the sake of the buttermilk, showed mercy to this cowherd boy and, continuing on His way, came to Navadvipa. The people of Navadvipa ran like madmen to see the Lord. Mother Shachi came to the Lord weeping and began to tell Him the grief of separation. Then Mahaprabhu said to Mother Shachi: "I abide near whoever serves Krishna," and, instructing her in the service of Krishna, spent a day in the bliss of kirtana in the house of Acharya Gosani at Shantipura, and then by way of Tamoluk reached Nilachala and showed mercy to King Prataparudra.

Raga suhai

নীলাচলে চলে প্রভু হরিষ-হিয়ায় ।
হাহা জগন্নাথ বলি' অনুরাগে ধায় ॥ ১ ॥

nīlācale cale prabhu hariṣa-hiẏāẏa |
hāhā jagannātha bali' anurāge dhāẏa || 1 ||

nilachale chale prabhu — the Lord goes to Nilachala; harisha-hiyaya — with a joyful heart; haha jagannatha bali — crying "O Jagannatha!"; anurage dhaya — He hastens in love

1With a joyful heart the Lord goes to Nilachala;
crying "O Jagannatha!" He hastens [there] in love1.

প্রেমানন্দে চলে প্রভু সিংহের গমনে ।
সংহতি চলিতে নারে সঙ্গের যত জনে ॥ ২ ॥

premānande cale prabhu siṃhera gamane |
saṃhati calite nāre saṅgera yata jane || 2 ||

premanande chale prabhu — the Lord goes in the bliss of prema; simhera gamane — with a lion's gait; samhati chalite nare — cannot keep pace; sangera yata jane — all who are with Him

2The Lord goes in the bliss of prema with a lion's gait;
all who are with Him cannot keep pace.

সঙ্গে যাইতে নারে, সঙ্গী দূরে পাছু আইল ।
অরণ্য-ভিতরে প্রভু একলা চলিল ॥ ৩ ॥

saṅge yāite nāre, saṅgī dūre pāchu āila |
araṇya-bhitare prabhu ekalā calila || 3 ||

sange yaite nare — they cannot go along; sangi dure pachhu aila — the companions came far behind; aranya-bhitare — through the forest; prabhu ekala chalila — the Lord went alone

3Unable to keep up, the companions fell far behind,
and the Lord went on alone through the forest.

অরণ্য-ভিতরে এক আছয়ে নগর ।
ঘোল বেচিবারে যায় গোয়ালা-কোঙর ॥ ৪ ॥

araṇya-bhitare eka āchaẏe nagara |
ghola becibāre yāẏa goẏālā-koṅara || 4 ||

aranya-bhitare — in the forest; eka achhaye nagara — there is a village; ghola bechibare yaya — goes to sell buttermilk; goyala-kongara — a cowherd youth

4In the forest there is a village;
a cowherd youth is going to sell buttermilk.

ঠাকুর দেখিল তারে, আবেশে তিয়াস ।
ঘোল দেহ গোপ—মোর লাগিল পিয়াস ॥ ৫ ॥

ṭhākura dekhila tāre, ābeśe tiẏāsa |
ghola deha gopa—mora lāgila piẏāsa || 5 ||

thakura dekhila tare — the Thakura saw him; aveshe tiyasa — thirsty in His ecstasy; ghola deha gopa — give buttermilk, cowherd; mora lagila piyasa — I am thirsty

5The Thakura saw him — in His ecstasy He was thirsty:
"Give Me buttermilk, cowherd, I am thirsty."

এ বোল শুনিঞা গোপ পড়িল চরণে ।
লেহ ঘোল—খাও গোসাঞি, যত লয় মনে ॥ ৬ ॥

e bola śuniñā gopa paṛila caraṇe |
leha ghola—khāo gosāñi, yata laẏa mane || 6 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; gopa padila charane — the cowherd fell at His feet; leha ghola — take the buttermilk; khao gosani — drink, Gosani; yata laya mane — as much as You like

6Hearing this, the cowherd fell at His feet:
"Take the buttermilk — drink, Gosani, as much as You like."

ঘোল পান কৈল—হৈল শূন্য কলসী ।
ঘোল খাঞা চলি' যায় কপট-সন্ন্যাসী ॥ ৭ ॥

ghola pāna kaila—haila śūnya kalasī |
ghola khāñā cali' yāẏa kapaṭa-sannyāsī || 7 ||

ghola pana kaila — He drank the buttermilk; haila shunya kalasi — the jar became empty; ghola khanya — having drunk the buttermilk; chali yaya kapata-sannyasi — the sannyasi-in-disguise walks on

7He drank the buttermilk — the jar was empty;
having drunk the buttermilk, the sannyasi — a sannyasi only in guise — walks on.

গোয়ালাকে বৈল—তুমি থাক এইখানে ।
পাছু যে আইসে, কড়ি নিহ তার স্থানে ॥ ৮ ॥

goẏālāke baila—tumi thāka eikhāne |
pāchu ye āise, kaṛi niha tāra sthāne || 8 ||

goyalake baila — He told the cowherd; tumi thaka eikhane — you stay here; pachhu ye aise — those who come behind; kadi niha tara sthane — take the money from them

8He told the cowherd: "Wait here:
take the money from those who come behind."

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
সেইখানে রহি' গোপ চিন্তয়ে অন্তর ॥ ৯ ॥

e bola baliẏā prabhu calilā satbara |
seikhāne rahi' gopa cintaẏe antara || 9 ||

e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord went off quickly; seikhane rahi — staying there; gopa chintaye antara — the cowherd ponders within

9Saying this, the Lord went off quickly,
and the cowherd, staying there, ponders within.

গোপ ভাবে—মিথ্যাকথা কহিল সন্ন্যাসী ।
এই মনে করি' গোপ মনে কত বাছি ॥ ৯+১ ॥

gopa bhābe—mithyākathā kahila sannyāsī |
ei mane kari' gopa mane kata bāchi || 9+1 ||

gopa bhave — the cowherd thinks; mithya-katha kahila sannyasi — the sannyasi has told a lie; ei mane kari — thinking so; gopa mane kata bachhi — the cowherd ponders long

9+1The cowherd thinks: "The sannyasi has told a lie," —
thinking so, the cowherd ponders long2:

ঘরে গিয়া কি বলিব নিজ পরিজনে ।
মিথ্যাকথা কহি' ন্যাসী করিল গমনে ॥ ৯+২ ॥

ghare giẏā ki baliba nija parijane |
mithyākathā kahi' nyāsī karila gamane || 9+2 ||

ghare giya — going home; ki baliba nija parijane — what shall I tell my family; mithya-katha kahi — telling a lie; nyasi karila gamane — the sannyasi went away

9+2"When I go home, what shall I tell my family?
The sannyasi told a lie and went away."

কথোক্ষণে সন্ন্যাসীর সঙ্গী যত জন ।
সেই পথে আইসে তারা প্রভুগত-মন ॥ ১০ ॥

kathokṣaṇe sannyāsīra saṅgī yata jana |
sei pathe āise tārā prabhugata-mana || 10 ||

kathokshane — after a while; sannyasira sangi yata jana — all the sannyasi's companions; sei pathe aise tara — come by that road; prabhu-gata-mana — their minds absorbed in the Lord

10After a while all the sannyasi's companions
come along that road, their minds absorbed in the Lord.

পুছিল—গোয়ালা, পথে দেখিলে সন্ন্যাসী ?
গোপ কহে—ঘোল খাইল একটা কলসী ॥ ১১ ॥

puchila—goẏālā, pathe dekhile sannyāsī ?
gopa kahe—ghola khāila ekaṭā kalasī || 11 ||

puchhila — they asked; goyala — cowherd; pathe dekhile sannyasi — did you see a sannyasi on the road?; gopa kahe — the cowherd says; ghola khaila ekta kalasi — He drank a whole jar of buttermilk

11They asked: "Cowherd, did you see a sannyasi on the road?"
The cowherd says: "He drank a whole jar of buttermilk

কড়ি নিতে বৈল মোরে তোমা-সভার ঠাঞি ।
যুয়ায় ত কড়ি দেহ—আমি ঘরে যাই ॥ ১২ ॥

kaṛi nite baila more tomā-sabhāra ṭhāñi |
yuẏāẏa ta kaṛi deha—āmi ghare yāi || 12 ||

kadi nite baila more — He told me to take the money; toma-sabhara thanyi — from you all; yuyaya ta kadi deha — give the proper money; ami ghare yai — and I will go home

12and told me to take the money from you.
Give what is proper, and I will go home."

এ বোল শুনিয়া সভে সভা-পানে চায় ।
সভে কহে—কড়ি কোথা আমা সভার ঠাঁয় ॥ ১৩ ॥

e bola śuniẏā sabhe sabhā-pāne cāẏa |
sabhe kahe—kaṛi kothā āmā sabhāra ṭhāṁẏa || 13 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; sabhe sabha-pane chaya — all look at one another; sabhe kahe — all say; kadi kotha ama sabhara thaya — where would we have money

13Hearing this, all look at one another;
all say: "Where would we have money?

জলপাত্র নাহি সঙ্গে, নাহি বহির্বাস ।
অঞ্জলিতে খাই জল লাগিলে পিয়াস ॥ ১৩+১ ॥

jalapātra nāhi saṅge, nāhi bahirbāsa |
añjalite khāi jala lāgile piẏāsa || 13+1 ||

jala-patra nahi sange — we have no water-pot with us; nahi bahirvasa — no outer cloth; anjalite khai jala — we drink water from cupped hands; lagile piyasa — when we are thirsty

13+1We have with us neither a water-pot nor an outer cloth:
when we are thirsty, we drink water from cupped hands"3.

গোয়ালা কহিল—চল, তবে নাহি দায় ।
মোর সেবা জানাইবা সন্ন্যাসীর পায় ॥ ১৪ ॥

goẏālā kahila—cala, tabe nāhi dāẏa |
mora sebā jānāibā sannyāsīra pāẏa || 14 ||

goyala kahila — the cowherd said; chala — go on; tabe nahi daya — then there is no debt; mora seva janaiba — convey my service; sannyasira paya — to the sannyasi's feet

14The cowherd said: "Go on, then there is no debt;
convey my obeisance to the sannyasi's feet."

এ বোল বলিয়া সে কলসী করে হাথে ।
ভারি বড় কলসী—তুলিতে নারে মাথে ॥ ১৫ ॥

e bola baliẏā se kalasī kare hāthe |
bhāri baṛa kalasī—tulite nāre māthe || 15 ||

e bola baliya — saying this; se kalasi kare hathe — he takes the jar in his hands; bhari bada kalasi — the jar is very heavy; tulite nare mathe — he cannot lift it onto his head

15Saying this, he takes the jar in his hands —
but the jar is very heavy; he cannot lift it onto his head.

ঢাকনা ঘুচাইয়া—রত্ন এক যে কলসী ।
ধাইয়া চলিল হাহা করিয়া সন্ন্যাসী ॥ ১৬ ॥

ḍhākanā ghucāiẏā—ratna eka ye kalasī |
dhāiẏā calila hāhā kariẏā sannyāsī || 16 ||

dhakana ghuchaiya — removing the lid; ratna eka ye kalasi — [sees] the jar full of jewels; dhaiya chalila — he ran off; haha kariya sannyasi — crying "O sannyasi!"

16Removing the lid, [he sees:] the jar is full of jewels —
and he ran off, crying "O sannyasi!"

কথোদূরে সঙ্গীর বিলম্বে আছে পঁহু ।
গোয়ালা দেখিয়া সে মুচকি হাসে লহু ॥ ১৭ ॥

kathodūre saṅgīra bilambe āche paṁhu |
goẏālā dekhiẏā se mucaki hāse lahu || 17 ||

kathodure — a little way on; sangira vilambe — waiting for the lagging companions; achhe panhu — the Lord stands; goyala dekhiya — seeing the cowherd; se muchaki hase lahu — He smiles softly

17A little way on, waiting for His lagging companions, stands the Lord;
seeing the cowherd, He smiles softly.

সঙ্গের যতেক জন আইল তখন ।
দেখিলা—গোয়ালা প্রভুর পাঞাছে চরণ ॥ ১৮ ॥

saṅgera yateka jana āila takhana |
dekhilā—goẏālā prabhura pāñāche caraṇa || 18 ||

sangera yateka jana — all the companions; aila takhana — came then; dekhila — they saw; goyala prabhura panyachhe charana — the cowherd had attained the Lord's feet

18Then all the companions came up
and saw: the cowherd had attained the Lord's feet.

প্রভু বোলে—গোপ, তুমি চলি' যাহ ঘর ।
তোরে অনুগ্রহ কৃষ্ণ কৈল—পাইলে বর ॥ ১৯ ॥

prabhu bole—gopa, tumi cali' yāha ghara |
tore anugraha kṛṣṇa kaila—pāile bara || 19 ||

prabhu bole — the Lord says; gopa tumi chali yaha ghara — cowherd, go home; tore anugraha krishna kaila — Krishna has shown you grace; paile vara — you have received a boon

19The Lord says: "Cowherd, go home:
Krishna has shown you grace; you have received a boon."

লেউটি' আসিতে গোপ পাইল পরসাদ ।
নাচিয়া বুলয়ে গোপ প্রেমার উন্মাদ ॥ ২০ ॥

leuṭi' āsite gopa pāila parasāda |
nāciẏā bulaẏe gopa premāra unmāda || 20 ||

leuti asite — on his way back; gopa paila parasada — the cowherd received grace; nachiya bulaye gopa — the cowherd goes about dancing; premara unmada — in the madness of prema

20On his way back the cowherd received grace:
the cowherd goes about dancing in the madness of prema.

গোয়ালা দেখিয়া সভার বাঢ়িল উল্লাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ২১ ॥

goẏālā dekhiẏā sabhāra bāṛhila ullāsa |
gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 21 ||

goyala dekhiya — seeing the cowherd; sabhara badhila ullasa — the joy of all increased; goraguna gaya sukhe — happily sings Gora's glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

21Seeing the cowherd, the joy of all increased;
happily this Lochana Dasa sings Gora's glories.

Raga shyamagada; disha: "Ah, my, ah, my Gauranga-sundara! Under the weight of youthful prema He cannot walk"

এইমতে ক্রমে ক্রমে পথে চলি' আইসে ।
সংহতি-সহিত উত্তরিলা গৌড়দেশে ॥ ২২ ॥

eimate krame krame pathe cali' āise |
saṃhati-sahita uttarilā gauṛadeśe || 22 ||

eimate krame krame — thus gradually; pathe chali aise — He comes along the road; samhati-sahita — together with His companions; uttarila gauda-deshe — He arrived in Gauda

22Thus step by step He comes along the road
and with His companions arrived in Gauda4.

গঙ্গাস্নান করি' প্রভু রাঢ়দেশ দিয়া ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে উত্তরিলা নগর কুলিয়া ॥ ২৩ ॥

gaṅgāsnāna kari' prabhu rāṛhadeśa diẏā |
krame krame uttarilā nagara kuliẏā || 23 ||

ganga-snana kari — bathing in the Ganga; prabhu radha-desha diya — the Lord, by way of Radha-desha; krame krame uttarila — gradually arrived; nagara kuliya — at the town of Kulia

23Bathing in the Ganga, the Lord, by way of Radha-desha,
gradually arrived at the town of Kulia.

পূর্বাশ্রম দেখিব—এ সন্ন্যাসীর ধর্ম ।
নবদ্বীপ-নিকটে গেলা—এই তার মর্ম ॥ ২৪ ॥

pūrbāśrama dekhiba—e sannyāsīra dharma |
nabadbīpa-nikaṭe gelā—ei tāra marma || 24 ||

purvashrama dekhiba — to see [the place of] one's former ashrama; e sannyasira dharma — this is a sannyasi's duty; navadvipa-nikate gela — He went near Navadvipa; ei tara marma — this is its meaning

24To see [the place of] one's former ashrama is a sannyasi's duty:
this is why He came near Navadvipa.

প্রভু-আগমন শুনি' নবদ্বীপের লোক ।
পুনঃ লেউটিলা সভে, পাশরিল শোক ॥ ২৫ ॥

prabhu-āgamana śuni' nabadbīpera loka |
punaḥ leuṭilā sabhe, pāśarila śoka || 25 ||

prabhu-agamana shuni — hearing of the Lord's coming; navadvipera loka — the people of Navadvipa; punah leutila sabhe — all came back to life, as it were; pasharila shoka — forgot their grief

25Hearing of the Lord's coming, the people of Navadvipa
came back to life, as it were, and forgot their grief.

হাহা গোরাচাঁদ বলি' অনুরাগে ধায় ।
কুলবধূ ধায়—তারা পাছ নাহি চায় ॥ ২৬ ॥

hāhā gorācāṁda bali' anurāge dhāẏa |
kulabadhū dhāẏa—tārā pācha nāhi cāẏa || 26 ||

haha gorachanda bali — crying "O Gorachand!"; anurage dhaya — they run in love; kulavadhu dhaya — the ladies of good families run; tara pachha nahi chaya — they do not look back

26Crying "O Gorachand!" they run [to Him] in love;
the ladies of good families run too, without looking back.

বিহ্বল-চেতন শচী ধায় ঊর্ধ্বমুখে ।
আউলাইল কেশ, বস্ত্র নাহি দেয় বুকে ॥ ২৭ ॥

bihbala-cetana śacī dhāẏa ūrdhbamukhe |
āulāila keśa, bastra nāhi deẏa buke || 27 ||

vihvala-chetana shachi — Shachi, beside herself; dhaya urdhva-mukhe — runs with upturned face; aulaila kesha — her hair dishevelled; vastra nahi deya buke — she does not draw her cloth over her breast

27Shachi, beside herself, runs with upturned face,
her hair dishevelled, her cloth not drawn over her breast.

কোথা মোর বিশ্বম্ভর—দেখাও মো নয়ানে ।
পুনঃ চুম্ব দিব সেই সুন্দর-বদনে ॥ ২৮ ॥

kothā mora biśbambhara—dekhāo mo naẏāne |
punaḥ cumba diba sei sundara-badane || 28 ||

kotha mora vishvambhara — where is my Vishvambhara; dekhao mo nayane — show him to my eyes; punah chumba diba — again I will kiss; sei sundara-vadane — that beautiful face

28"Where is my Vishvambhara? Show him to my eyes!
I will kiss that beautiful face again.

নদিয়া-নগরে আইল আমার নিমাই ।
ধরিয়া রাখহ লোক—কিছু দোষ নাই ॥ ২৯ ॥

nadiẏā-nagare āila āmāra nimāi |
dhariẏā rākhaha loka—kichu doṣa nāi || 29 ||

nadiya-nagare aila — to the town of Nadia has come; amara nimai — my Nimai; dhariya rakhaha loka — people, seize and keep him; kichhu dosha nai — there is no wrong in it

29My Nimai has come to Nadia!
People, seize him and keep him — there is no wrong in it.

সভাকার প্রাণ সেই—সেই মাত্র জীউ ।
প্রাণ বিনা ধর্ম রক্ষা কোন্ রীতে হউ ॥ ৩০ ॥

sabhākāra prāṇa sei—sei mātra jīu |
prāṇa binā dharma rakṣā kon rīte hau || 30 ||

sabhakara prana sei — he is the life of all; sei matra jiu — he alone is the soul; prana vina — without life; dharma raksha kon rite hau — how can dharma be kept

30He is the life of all; he alone is the soul:
without life, how can dharma be kept?"

এইমতে কহিতে কহিতে গেলা তথা ।
দেখিল সে গৌরচন্দ্র বসি' আছে যথা ॥ ৩১ ॥

eimate kahite kahite gelā tathā |
dekhila se gauracandra basi' āche yathā || 31 ||

eimate kahite kahite — saying such things; gela tatha — she went there; dekhila se — she saw; gaurachandra basi achhe yatha — where Gaurachandra was sitting

31Saying such things she came there
and saw where Gaurachandra was sitting.

প্রভুরে দেখিয়া বোলে—শুন রে নিমাই ।
ঘরে চল—আমার সন্ন্যাসে কাজ নাই ॥ ৩২ ॥

prabhure dekhiẏā bole—śuna re nimāi |
ghare cala—āmāra sannyāse kāja nāi || 32 ||

prabhure dekhiya — seeing the Lord; bole — she says; shuna re nimai — listen, Nimai; ghare chala — come home; amara sannyase kaja nai — I have no use for [your] sannyasa

32Seeing the Lord, she says: "Listen, Nimai!
Come home — I have no use for [your] sannyasa.

সন্ন্যাস করিয়া ধর্ম রাখিবি তো পাছু ।
মোর বধ আগে লাগে—আর সব পাছু ॥ ৩৩ ॥

sannyāsa kariẏā dharma rākhibi to pāchu |
mora badha āge lāge—āra saba pāchu || 33 ||

sannyasa kariya — taking sannyasa; dharma rakhibi to pachhu — you will keep dharma later; mora vadha age lage — first the [sin of] my death clings [to you]; ara saba pachhu — all else afterwards

33By sannyasa you will keep dharma later,
but first the [sin of] my death will cling to you — everything else after."

বিহ্বল-চেতন শচী কান্দে উভরায় ।
সকল শরীরখানি একদৃষ্টে চায় ॥ ৩৪ ॥

bihbala-cetana śacī kānde ubharāẏa |
sakala śarīrakhāni ekadṛṣṭe cāẏa || 34 ||

vihvala-chetana shachi — Shachi, beside herself; kande ubharaya — weeps aloud; sakala sharira-khani — at His whole body; ekadrishte chaya — she gazes fixedly

34Shachi, beside herself, weeps aloud
and gazes fixedly at His whole body.

বাপু বাপু বলি' অঙ্গ পরশিতে চায় ।
আর সব থাকু, বাপ—হাথ দেয় গায় ॥ ৩৫ ॥

bāpu bāpu bali' aṅga paraśite cāẏa |
āra saba thāku, bāpa—hātha deẏa gāẏa || 35 ||

bapu bapu bali — saying "my son, my son"; anga parashite chaya — she wants to touch His body; ara saba thaku bapa — let all else be, my son; hatha deya gaya — she lays her hand on His body

35Saying "My son, my son!" she wants to touch His body:
"Let all else be, my son," — and she lays her hand on Him.

শ্রীঅঙ্গে লেগেছে ধূলা—ফেলাঙ ঝাড়িয়া ।
এ বোল বলিয়া পড়ে অঙ্গ আছাড়িয়া ॥ ৩৬ ॥

śrīaṅge legeche dhūlā—phelāṅa jhāṛiẏā |
e bola baliẏā paṛe aṅga āchāṛiẏā || 36 ||

sri-ange legechhe dhula — dust has clung to His holy body; phelanga jhadiya — let me brush it off; e bola baliya — saying this; pade anga achhadiya — she falls, flinging herself down

36"Dust has clung to the holy body — let me brush it off" —
saying this, she falls, flinging herself down.

পুনঃ উঠি' বলে—বাপু, শুন মোর বোল ।
মিটাউ হিয়ার সাধ—ধরি' দেও কোল ॥ ৩৭ ॥

punaḥ uṭhi' bale—bāpu, śuna mora bola |
miṭāu hiẏāra sādha—dhari' deo kola || 37 ||

punah uthi bale — rising again she says; bapu shuna mora bola — my son, hear my word; mitau hiyara sadha — let me fulfil my heart's longing; dhari deo kola — let me hold you in my arms

37And again, rising, she says: "My son, listen to me:
fulfil my heart's longing — let me hold you in my arms."

শচীর কান্দনা দেখি' পৃথিবী বিদরে ।
আছুক মানুষের কাজ, এ পাষাণ ঝুরে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

śacīra kāndanā dekhi' pṛthibī bidare |
āchuka mānuṣera kāja, e pāṣāṇa jhure || 38 ||

shachira kandana dekhi — seeing Shachi's weeping; prithivi vidare — the earth splits; achhuka manushera kaja — let alone people; e pashana jhure — even stones weep

38At the sight of Shachi's weeping the earth splits;
let alone people — even stones weep.

চৌদিগে সকল লোক কান্দিয়া ফাঁপর ।
কাছ না ছাড়য়ে কেহো—পাশরিল ঘর ॥ ৩৯ ॥

caudige sakala loka kāndiẏā phāṁpara |
kācha nā chāṛaẏe keho—pāśarila ghara || 39 ||

chaudige sakala loka — all the people around; kandiya phanpara — are distraught with weeping; kachha na chhadaye keho — no one leaves His side; pasharila ghara — they forgot their homes

39All the people around are distraught with weeping;
no one leaves His side; all have forgotten their homes.

লোকের কান্দনা দেখি' মায়ের ব্যগ্রতা ।
মনে অনুমানে প্রভু—কি কহিব কথা ॥ ৪০ ॥

lokera kāndanā dekhi' māẏera byagratā |
mane anumāne prabhu—ki kahiba kathā || 40 ||

lokera kandana dekhi — seeing the people's weeping; mayera vyagrata — [and] His mother's distress; mane anumane prabhu — the Lord considers in His mind; ki kahiba katha — what to say

40Seeing the people weeping and His mother's distress,
the Lord considers: "What shall I say?"

মায়ে প্রবোধিতে প্রভু মনে মনে গুণে ।
না কান্দ না কান্দ বোলে মধুর বচনে ॥ ৪১ ॥

māẏe prabodhite prabhu mane mane guṇe |
nā kānda nā kānda bole madhura bacane || 41 ||

maye prabodhite — how to console His mother; prabhu mane mane gune — the Lord ponders within; na kanda na kanda bole — He says "do not weep, do not weep"; madhura vachane — with sweet words

41Pondering within how to console His mother,
the Lord says sweetly: "Do not weep, do not weep!

সন্ন্যাস করিতে আজ্ঞা করিলা আপনে ।
এখন বিহ্বল হঞা কান্দ কি কারণে ॥ ৪২ ॥

sannyāsa karite ājñā karilā āpane |
ekhana bihbala hañā kānda ki kāraṇe || 42 ||

sannyasa karite — to take sannyasa; ajna karila apane — you yourself gave permission; ekhana vihvala hanya — now, overwhelmed; kanda ki karane — why do you weep

42You yourself gave permission to take sannyasa —
why then, overwhelmed, do you weep now?

পুত্র বলি' মিছা মায়া না ঘুচিল তোর ।
এছন দুস্ত্যজ মায়া এ সংসার-ঘোর ॥ ৪৩ ॥

putra bali' michā māẏā nā ghucila tora |
echana dustyaja māẏā e saṃsāra-ghora || 43 ||

putra bali — [attachment] as to a son; michha maya — vain maya; na ghuchila tora — has not left you; echhana dustyaja maya — so hard to cast off is the maya; e samsara-ghora — of this dreadful samsara

43The vain maya — [attachment to Me] as to a son — has not left you:
so hard to cast off is the maya of this dreadful samsara!5

ঘুচিলে না ঘুচে মায়া এছন দারুণ ।
শচী বোলে—মোর বোল শুন নিকরুণ ॥ ৪৪ ॥

ghucile nā ghuce māẏā echana dāruṇa |
śacī bole—mora bola śuna nikaruṇa || 44 ||

ghuchile na ghuche — though driven away it does not go; maya echhana daruna — so cruel is maya; shachi bole — Shachi says; mora bola shuna nikaruna — hear my word, pitiless one

44Driven away, it does not go: so cruel is maya."
Shachi says: "Hear me, pitiless one!

মোর পুত্র বলি' জন্ম লৈলে পৃথিবীতে ।
জগতের লোক মোরে কৈল পূজিতে ॥ ৪৫ ॥

mora putra bali' janma laile pṛthibīte |
jagatera loka more kaila pūjite || 45 ||

mora putra bali — as my son; janma laile prithivite — you took birth on earth; jagatera loka — the people of the world; more kaila pujite — you made them honour me

45You took birth on earth as my son
and made the people of the world honour me.

তুমি সব-লোকবন্ধু, ত্রিজগতে পূজি ।
তোমার সে স্নেহ-মায়া শাস্ত্রে ভাল বুঝি ॥ ৪৬ ॥

tumi saba-lokabandhu, trijagate pūji |
tomāra se sneha-māẏā śāstre bhāla bujhi || 46 ||

tumi saba-loka-bandhu — You are the friend of all people; tri-jagate puji — worshipped in the three worlds; tomara se sneha-maya — this "maya" of Your affection; shastre bhala bujhi — I understand well from the scriptures

46You are the friend of all, worshipped in the three worlds;
this 'maya' of Your affection I understand well from the scriptures.

যে হউ সে হউ মোর, তুমি হও পুত্র ।
জন্মে জন্মে রহু মোর এই কর্মসূত্র ॥ ৪৭ ॥

ye hau se hau mora, tumi hao putra |
janme janme rahu mora ei karmasūtra || 47 ||

ye hau se hau mora — whatever happens to me; tumi hao putra — be my son; janme janme rahu — birth after birth may there remain; mora ei karma-sutra — this thread of my destiny

47Whatever becomes of me — be my son:
birth after birth may this thread of destiny remain mine."

মায়ের বচনে প্রভু আস্তব্যস্ত হঞা ।
মায়ায়ে জিনিতে নারে, উভরায়ে দয়া ॥ ৪৮ ॥

māẏera bacane prabhu āstabyasta hañā |
māẏāẏe jinite nāre, ubharāẏe daẏā || 48 ||

mayera vachane — at His mother's words; prabhu astavyasta hanya — the Lord, perturbed; mayaye jinite nare — cannot overcome [her] "maya"; ubharaye daya — compassion overflows

48At His mother's words the Lord was perturbed:
He cannot overcome her 'maya'; compassion overflows in Him6.

যে তোর আছয়ে ইচ্ছা, কর নিজ-সুখে ।
একমাত্র শেষ আমি নিবেদিনু তোকে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

ye tora āchaẏe icchā, kara nija-sukhe |
ekamātra śeṣa āmi nibedinu toke || 49 ||

ye tora achhaye ichchha — whatever wish you have; kara nija-sukhe — do as pleases you; ekamatra shesha — only one last thing; ami nivedinu toke — I have put before you

49"Whatever you wish, do as pleases you;
I have told you only one last thing."

শচী বোলে—নবদ্বীপ ছাড়ি' যাহ তুমি ।
নবদ্বীপে দুঃখী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া আর আমি ॥ ৫০ ॥

śacī bole—nabadbīpa chāṛi' yāha tumi |
nabadbīpe duḥkhī biṣṇupriẏā āra āmi || 50 ||

shachi bole — Shachi says; navadvipa chhadi yaha tumi — you go, leaving Navadvipa; navadvipe duhkhi — in Navadvipa grieving; vishnupriya ara ami — are Vishnupriya and I

50Shachi says: "You are going away, leaving Navadvipa —
and in Navadvipa Vishnupriya and I are grieving."

মায়ের বচনে পুনঃ গেলা নবদ্বীপ ।
বারকোণা-ঘাট নিজ-বাড়ীর সমীপ ॥ ৫১ ॥

māẏera bacane punaḥ gelā nabadbīpa |
bārakoṇā-ghāṭa nija-bāṛīra samīpa || 51 ||

mayera vachane — at His mother's word; punah gela navadvipa — He went again to Navadvipa; barakona-ghata — the Barakona-ghata; nija-badira samipa — near His own house

51At His mother's word He went again to Navadvipa,
to the Barakona-ghata, near His own house.

শুক্লাম্বর-ব্রহ্মচারি-ঘরে ভিক্ষা কৈল ।
মায়ে নমস্করি' প্রভু প্রভাতে চলিল ॥ ৫২ ॥

śuklāmbara-brahmacāri-ghare bhikṣā kaila |
māẏe namaskari' prabhu prabhāte calila || 52 ||

shuklambara-brahmachari-ghare — at the house of Shuklambara Brahmachari; bhiksha kaila — He took alms; maye namaskari — bowing to His mother; prabhu prabhate chalila — the Lord left in the morning

52He took alms in the house of Shuklambara Brahmachari
and in the morning, bowing to His mother, departed.

মায়েরে কহিল—মুঞি বন্দী তোর গুণে ।
পুরুব-রহস্য-কথা পাশরিলে কেনে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

māẏere kahila—muñi bandī tora guṇe |
puruba-rahasya-kathā pāśarile kene || 53 ||

mayere kahila — He told His mother; munyi bandi tora gune — I am captive to your virtues; puruba-rahasya-katha — the secret of the past; pasharile kene — why have you forgotten

53He told His mother: "I am captive to your virtues;
why have you forgotten the secret of the past?

রাম কৃষ্ণ বামন কপিল আদি আমি ।
সর্বজন্ম দেখ সব বিচারিয়া তুমি ॥ ৫৩+১ ॥

rāma kṛṣṇa bāmana kapila ādi āmi |
sarbajanma dekha saba bicāriẏā tumi || 53+1 ||

rama krishna vamana kapila adi ami — I am Rama, Krishna, Vamana, Kapila and the rest; sarva-janma dekha — look at all the births; saba vichariya tumi — considering everything

53+1I am Rama, Krishna, Vamana, Kapila and the rest:
look at all the births, considering everything7.

সর্বকাল আমার সে এইমত কর্ম ।
তোমার নিকটে আছি—জান এই মর্ম ॥ ৫৩+২ ॥

sarbakāla āmāra se eimata karma |
tomāra nikaṭe āchi—jāna ei marma || 53+2 ||

sarvakala amara se — at all times My; eimata karma — such is the way; tomara nikate achhi — I am near you; jana ei marma — know this truth

53+2At all times such is My way:
I am near you — know this truth.

এবে ত ভকতি-রসে মোর অবতার ।
কৃষ্ণচন্দ্র বহি কিছু না ভজিব আর ॥ ৫৩+৩ ॥

ebe ta bhakati-rase mora abatāra |
kṛṣṇacandra bahi kichu nā bhajiba āra || 53+3 ||

ebe ta bhakati-rase — now for the rasa of devotion; mora avatara — is My descent; krishnachandra bahi — except Krishnachandra; kichhu na bhajiba ara — I shall worship nothing else

53+3Now My descent is for the rasa of devotion:
except Krishnachandra, I shall worship nothing.

কিবা ভক্ত কিবা বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া কিবা তুমি ।
যে ভজয়ে কৃষ্ণ—তার কোলে আছি আমি ॥ ৫৪ ॥

kibā bhakta kibā biṣṇupriẏā kibā tumi |
ye bhajaẏe kṛṣṇa—tāra kole āchi āmi || 54 ||

kiba bhakta — be it a devotee; kiba vishnupriya — be it Vishnupriya; kiba tumi — be it you; ye bhajaye krishna — whoever worships Krishna; tara kole achhi ami — I am in that one's embrace

54Be it a devotee, be it Vishnupriya, be it you —
whoever worships Krishna, I am in that one's embrace"8.

মায়ে নমস্করি' প্রভু বোলে বার বার ।
না ছাড়িহ কৃষ্ণ, না ভজিহ এ সংসার ॥ ৫৫ ॥

māẏe namaskari' prabhu bole bāra bāra |
nā chāṛiha kṛṣṇa, nā bhajiha e saṃsāra || 55 ||

maye namaskari — bowing to His mother; prabhu bole bara bara — the Lord says again and again; na chhadiha krishna — do not abandon Krishna; na bhajiha e samsara — do not serve this samsara

55Bowing to His mother, the Lord says again and again:
"Do not abandon Krishna; do not serve this samsara."

শচীর অন্তর-হিয়া করে দপ দপ ।
চলিল ঠাকুর, পাছে ধায় ভক্ত সব ॥ ৫৬ ॥

śacīra antara-hiẏā kare dapa dapa |
calila ṭhākura, pāche dhāẏa bhakta saba || 56 ||

shachira antara-hiya — Shachi's inmost heart; kare dapa dapa — throbs; chalila thakura — the Thakura went; pachhe dhaya bhakta saba — all the devotees run behind

56Shachi's heart throbs;
the Thakura went; all the devotees run behind.

শান্তিপুরে গেলা আচার্যের ঘর ।
কীর্তন-বিলাসে গেল সে অষ্টপ্রহর ॥ ৫৭ ॥

śāntipure gelā ācāryera ghara |
kīrtana-bilāse gela se aṣṭaprahara || 57 ||

shantipure gela — He went to Shantipura; acharyera ghara — to the Acharya's house; kirtana-vilase — in the joy of kirtana; gela se ashta-prahara — passed a day and a night (eight praharas)

57He went to Shantipura, to the Acharya's house;
in the joy of kirtana a day and a night passed.

পুনঃ পরভাতে প্রভু চলিলা সত্বরে ।
উৎকণ্ঠা বাঢ়িল জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

punaḥ parabhāte prabhu calilā satbare |
utkaṇṭhā bāṛhila jagannātha dekhibāre || 58 ||

punah parabhate — again in the morning; prabhu chalila satvare — the Lord set out quickly; utkantha badhila — His longing grew; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha

58Next morning the Lord again set out quickly:
His longing to see Jagannatha grew.

সভারে কহিলা প্রভু—সভে যাহ ঘর ।
নীলাচলে আছি আমি—কহিল উত্তর ॥ ৫৯ ॥

sabhāre kahilā prabhu—sabhe yāha ghara |
nīlācale āchi āmi—kahila uttara || 59 ||

sabhare kahila prabhu — the Lord told everyone; sabhe yaha ghara — all of you go home; nilachale achhi ami — I am in Nilachala; kahila uttara — so He answered

59The Lord told everyone: "All of you go home;
I am in Nilachala" — so He answered.

যে যায় তথায় জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে ।
তথায় আমার দেখা হৈব সভারে ॥ ৬০ ॥

ye yāẏa tathāẏa jagannātha dekhibāre |
tathāẏa āmāra dekhā haiba sabhāre || 60 ||

ye yaya tathaya — whoever goes there; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha; tathaya amara dekha — there a meeting with Me; haiba sabhare — all will have

60"Whoever goes there to see Jagannatha —
there all will meet Me."

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু বোলে হরিবোল ।
চলিলা ঠাকুর—উঠে কান্দনের রোল ॥ ৬১ ॥

e bola baliẏā prabhu bole haribola |
calilā ṭhākura—uṭhe kāndanera rola || 61 ||

e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu bole hari-bola — the Lord cries "Hari-bol!"; chalila thakura — the Thakura went; uthe kandanera rola — a sound of weeping rises

61Saying this, the Lord cries "Hari-bol!"
The Thakura went — a sound of weeping rises.

ক্রমে ক্রমে তমোলুকে উত্তরিলা গিয়া ।
যে পথে আসিয়াছেন পূর্বে সেই পথ দিয়া ॥ ৬২ ॥

krame krame tamoluke uttarilā giẏā |
ye pathe āsiẏāchena pūrbe sei patha diẏā || 62 ||

krame krame — gradually; tamoluke uttarila giya — He reached Tamoluk; ye pathe asiyachhena purve — by the way He came before; sei patha diya — by that same way

62Step by step He came to Tamoluk,
by the same way as He had come before.

পথে চলি' যায় প্রভু প্রেমানন্দ-সুখে ।
প্রেম-বরিষণে ভাসে সে পথের লোকে ॥ ৬৩ ॥

pathe cali' yāẏa prabhu premānanda-sukhe |
prema-bariṣaṇe bhāse se pathera loke || 63 ||

pathe chali yaya prabhu — the Lord goes along the road; premananda-sukhe — in the joy of prema's bliss; prema-varishane bhase — float in the rain of prema; se pathera loke — the people along that road

63The Lord goes along the road in the joy of prema's bliss;
the people along that road float in the rain of prema.

হাসিতে খেলিতে যায়, নাহি পথশ্রমে ।
পুরুষোত্তমে উত্তরিলা পথ ক্রমে ক্রমে ॥ ৬৪ ॥

hāsite khelite yāẏa, nāhi pathaśrame |
puruṣottame uttarilā patha krame krame || 64 ||

hasite khelite yaya — He goes laughing and playing; nahi patha-shrame — without the fatigue of the road; purushottame uttarila — He reached Purushottama; patha krame krame — step by step

64He goes laughing and playing, without the fatigue of the road,
and step by step reached Purushottama.

দেখিব ত জগন্নাথ নীলাচলরায় ।
হাহা জগন্নাথ বলি' অনুরাগে ধায় ॥ ৬৫ ॥

dekhiba ta jagannātha nīlācalarāẏa |
hāhā jagannātha bali' anurāge dhāẏa || 65 ||

dekhiba ta jagannatha — I shall see Jagannatha; nilachala-raya — the King of Nilachala; haha jagannatha bali — crying "O Jagannatha!"; anurage dhaya — He hastens in love

65"I shall see Jagannatha, the King of Nilachala!" —
crying "O Jagannatha!" He hastens in love.

সিংহদ্বারে গিয়া প্রভু ছাড়ে হুহুঙ্কার ।
পাইল সকল লোক আনন্দ অপার ॥ ৬৬ ॥

siṃhadbāre giẏā prabhu chāṛe huhuṅkāra |
pāila sakala loka ānanda apāra || 66 ||

simha-dvare giya — coming to the Lion Gate; prabhu chhade huhunkara — the Lord lets out a roar; paila sakala loka — all the people found; ananda apara — boundless joy

66Coming to the Lion Gate, the Lord lets out a roar;
all the people found boundless joy.

জগন্নাথ দেখি' তুষ্ট হৈলা গোরারায় ।
তাঁহারে দেখিয়া লোক বড় সুখ পায় ॥ ৬৭ ॥

jagannātha dekhi' tuṣṭa hailā gorārāẏa |
tāṁhāre dekhiẏā loka baṛa sukha pāẏa || 67 ||

jagannatha dekhi — seeing Jagannatha; tushta haila goraraya — Goraraya was delighted; tanhare dekhiya — seeing Him; loka bada sukha paya — the people find great happiness

67Seeing Jagannatha, Goraraya was delighted;
seeing Him, the people find great happiness.

হরি হরি বোলে লোক উচ্চ উচ্চ-রায় ।
আনন্দিত দিবা-নিশি হরিগুণ গায় ॥ ৬৮ ॥

hari hari bole loka ucca ucca-rāẏa |
ānandita dibā-niśi hariguṇa gāẏa || 68 ||

hari hari bole loka — the people cry "Hari, Hari!"; uchcha uchcha-raya — with loud voices; anandita diva-nishi — joyful day and night; hari-guna gaya — they sing Hari's glories

68The people cry with loud voices: "Hari, Hari!"
and joyfully sing Hari's glories day and night.

রাত্রি দিন করে প্রভু কীর্তন-বিলাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৬৯ ॥

rātri dina kare prabhu kīrtana-bilāsa |
gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 69 ||

ratri dina — night and day; kare prabhu kirtana-vilasa — the Lord delights in kirtana; goraguna gaya sukhe — happily sings Gora's glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

69Night and day the Lord delights in kirtana;
happily this Lochana Dasa sings Gora's glories.

Raga lalita; disha: "Sing, sing of Gora's glories — the blessing of the whole world!"

আনন্দিত মহাপ্রভু আছে নীলাচলে ।
হরিগুণ-সঙ্কীর্তন করে ভক্তমেলে ॥ ৭০ ॥

ānandita mahāprabhu āche nīlācale |
hariguṇa-saṅkīrtana kare bhaktamele || 70 ||

anandita mahaprabhu — joyful Mahaprabhu; achhe nilachale — stays in Nilachala; hari-guna-sankirtana — the sankirtana of Hari's glories; kare bhakta-mele — He performs among the devotees

70Joyful Mahaprabhu stays in Nilachala
and among the devotees performs the sankirtana of Hari's glories.

অনেক ভকতগণ মিলিলা তথায় ।
নিত্যই নূতন প্রকাশয়ে গোরারায় ॥ ৭১ ॥

aneka bhakatagaṇa mililā tathāẏa |
nityai nūtana prakāśaẏe gorārāẏa || 71 ||

aneka bhakatagana — many devotees; milila tathaya — gathered there; nityai nutana — ever new each day; prakashaye goraraya — Goraraya reveals [Himself]

71Many devotees gathered there;
every day Goraraya reveals Himself anew.

হেনই সময়ে কথা কহিব এখনে ।
প্রতাপরুদ্রেরে কৃপা কৈল যেন মনে ॥ ৭২ ॥

henai samaẏe kathā kahiba ekhane |
pratāparudrere kṛpā kaila yena mane || 72 ||

henai samaye — at that time; katha kahiba ekhane — I shall now tell; prataparudrere — to Prataparudra; kripa kaila yena mane — how [He] showed mercy as He willed

72Now I shall tell how at that time
He, as He willed, showed mercy to Prataparudra9.

লোকমুখে শুনি' রাজা মহাপ্রভুর গুণ ।
আশ্চর্য মানয়ে, সে না কহে কিছু পুনঃ ॥ ৭৩ ॥

lokamukhe śuni' rājā mahāprabhura guṇa |
āścarya mānaẏe, se nā kahe kichu punaḥ || 73 ||

loka-mukhe shuni — hearing from people; raja mahaprabhura guna — the king, of Mahaprabhu's glories; ashcharya manaye — marvels; se na kahe kichhu punah — but says nothing

73Hearing from people of Mahaprabhu's glories,
the king marvels but says nothing.

একদিন গেলা জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে ।
জগন্নাথ না দেখয়ে—দেখে ন্যাসিবরে ॥ ৭৪ ॥

ekadina gelā jagannātha dekhibāre |
jagannātha nā dekhaẏe—dekhe nyāsibare || 74 ||

ekadina gela — one day he went; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha; jagannatha na dekhaye — he does not see Jagannatha; dekhe nyasivare — he sees the best of sannyasis

74One day he went to see Jagannatha —
and does not see Jagannatha, but sees the best of sannyasis.

কি কি বলি' মনে গুণে বিস্মিত হিয়ায় ।
পড়িছাকে পুছে রাজা—কি দেখহ রায় ॥ ৭৫ ॥

ki ki bali' mane guṇe bismita hiẏāẏa |
paṛichāke puche rājā—ki dekhaha rāẏa || 75 ||

ki ki bali — "what, what [is this]?"; mane gune — he ponders; vismita hiyaya — with an astonished heart; padichhake puchhe raja — the king asks the padichha; ki dekhaha raya — what do you see, sir

75"What is this, what?" he ponders with an astonished heart
and asks the padichha: "What do you see, sir?"

পড়িছা কহয়ে—দেব জগন্নাথ দেখি ।
রাজা কহে—তো-সভাকে ব্যর্থ আমি রাখি ॥ ৭৬ ॥

paṛichā kahaẏe—deba jagannātha dekhi |
rājā kahe—to-sabhāke byartha āmi rākhi || 76 ||

padichha kahaye — the padichha says; deva jagannatha dekhi — I see Lord Jagannatha; raja kahe — the king says; to-sabhake vyartha ami rakhi — I keep you all in vain

76The padichha says: "I see Lord Jagannatha."
The king says: "I keep you all in vain!

জগন্নাথ-স্থানে ন্যাসী বসি' আছে হের ।
মোর দণ্ড-ভয়ে কিছু না দেখিয়ে বোল ॥ ৭৭ ॥

jagannātha-sthāne nyāsī basi' āche hera |
mora daṇḍa-bhaẏe kichu nā dekhiẏe bola || 77 ||

jagannatha-sthane — in Jagannatha's place; nyasi basi achhe hera — here sits a sannyasi; mora danda-bhaye — in fear of my punishment; kichhu na dekhiye bola — you say you see nothing [else]

77Look, in Jagannatha's place sits a sannyasi —
and you, for fear of my punishment, say you see nothing [else].

আঁখি ভাঁড়িমু যেন—হেন নহে কভু ।
নহে বা কি দেখ সত্য করি' কহ তভু ॥ ৭৮ ॥

āṁkhi bhāṁṛimu yena—hena nahe kabhu |
nahe bā ki dekha satya kari' kaha tabhu || 78 ||

ankhi bhandimu yena — as if my eyes deceived me; hena nahe kabhu — that is never so; nahe va ki dekha — or else what do you see; satya kari kaha tabhu — tell the truth then

78As if my eyes deceived me — that is never so!
Or else — what do you see? Tell the truth."

এ বোল শুনিঞা পড়িছা বোলে পুনর্বার ।
জগন্নাথ বহি মোরা নাহি দেখি আর ॥ ৭৯ ॥

e bola śuniñā paṛichā bole punarbāra |
jagannātha bahi morā nāhi dekhi āra || 79 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; padichha bole punarvara — the padichha says again; jagannatha bahi — except Jagannatha; mora nahi dekhi ara — we see nothing else

79Hearing this, the padichha says again:
"Except Jagannatha we see nothing"10.

তবে ত প্রতাপরুদ্র গুণে মনে মনে ।
সন্ন্যাসীকে কেনে দেখি আমার নয়নে ॥ ৮০ ॥

tabe ta pratāparudra guṇe mane mane |
sannyāsīke kene dekhi āmāra naẏane || 80 ||

tabe ta prataparudra — then Prataparudra; gune mane mane — ponders within; sannyasike kene dekhi — why do I see the sannyasi; amara nayane — with my eyes

80Then Prataparudra ponders within:
"Why then do I see the sannyasi with my own eyes?

শুনিয়াছি সন্ন্যাসীর মহিমা অপার ।
ইহার কারণ তবে করিব বিচার ॥ ৮১ ॥

śuniẏāchi sannyāsīra mahimā apāra |
ihāra kāraṇa tabe kariba bicāra || 81 ||

shuniyachhi — I have heard; sannyasira mahima apara — the sannyasi's greatness is boundless; ihara karana — the cause of this; tabe kariba vichara — I shall then look into

81I have heard that this sannyasi's greatness is boundless;
I must look into the cause of this."

এতেক গুণিয়া রাজা চলিল সত্বর ।
আপনি চলিলা যথা আছে ন্যাসিবর ॥ ৮২ ॥

eteka guṇiẏā rājā calila satbara |
āpani calilā yathā āche nyāsibara || 82 ||

eteka guniya — having thought thus; raja chalila satvara — the king went quickly; apani chalila — he went himself; yatha achhe nyasivara — to where the best of sannyasis was

82Having thought thus, the king went quickly —
went himself to where the best of sannyasis was.

দেখিল টোটায়ে ন্যাসী আছে নিজ-মেলে ।
বৃন্দাবন-কথা কহে, হরি হরি বোলে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

dekhila ṭoṭāẏe nyāsī āche nija-mele |
bṛndābana-kathā kahe, hari hari bole || 83 ||

dekhila totaye — he saw in the garden; nyasi achhe nija-mele — the sannyasi among His own; vrindavana-katha kahe — He tells of Vrindavana; hari hari bole — He cries "Hari, Hari!"

83He saw: in the garden the sannyasi, among His own,
tells of Vrindavana and cries: "Hari, Hari!"

পুনরপি জগন্নাথ দেখি' আরবার ।
দেখিল সন্ন্যাসী সেই সুমেরু-আকার ॥ ৮৪ ॥

punarapi jagannātha dekhi' ārabāra |
dekhila sannyāsī sei sumeru-ākāra || 84 ||

punarapi — again; jagannatha dekhi arabara — looking at Jagannatha once more; dekhila sannyasi sei — he saw that sannyasi; sumeru-akara — as vast as Sumeru

84Again, looking at Jagannatha once more,
he saw that sannyasi, as vast as Mount Sumeru.

দেখিয়া রাজার ভেল হিয়া চমৎকার ।
এই জগন্নাথ—সেই ন্যাসি-অবতার ॥ ৮৫ ॥

dekhiẏā rājāra bhela hiẏā camatkāra |
ei jagannātha—sei nyāsi-abatāra || 85 ||

dekhiya — seeing this; rajara bhela hiya chamatkara — the king's heart was amazed; ei jagannatha — this Jagannatha; sei nyasi-avatara — is that sannyasi-avatara

85Seeing this, the king was amazed at heart:
"This Jagannatha is that very sannyasi-avatara!"

প্রতাপরুদ্রের মনে বাঢ়ে অনুরাগ ।
সত্বরে চলিলা যথা আছে মহাভাগ ॥ ৮৬ ॥

pratāparudrera mane bāṛhe anurāga |
satbare calilā yathā āche mahābhāga || 86 ||

prataparudrera mane — in Prataparudra's heart; badhe anuraga — love grows; satvare chalila — he went quickly; yatha achhe mahabhaga — to where the Glorious One was

86Love grows in Prataparudra's heart,
and he went quickly to where the Glorious One was.

টোটায় নাহিক কেহো—ভাঙ্গিল দেওয়ান ।
গোবিন্দেরে কহে রাজা কাতর-বয়ান ॥ ৮৭ ॥

ṭoṭāẏa nāhika keho—bhāṅgila deoẏāna |
gobindere kahe rājā kātara-baẏāna || 87 ||

totaya nahika keho — there is no one in the garden; bhangila deoyana — the gathering has broken up; govindere kahe raja — the king says to Govinda; katara-bayana — in a pleading voice

87There is no one in the garden — the gathering has broken up;
the king pleadingly says to Govinda11:

কোন মতে দেখোঁ মুঞি গোসাঞির চরণ ।
ইহার উপায় মোরে কহ মহাজন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

kona mate dekhoṁ muñi gosāñira caraṇa |
ihāra upāẏa more kaha mahājana || 88 ||

kona mate dekhon munyi — how may I see; gosanira charana — the Gosani's feet; ihara upaya — the means for it; more kaha mahajana — tell me, great one

88"How may I see the Gosani's feet?
Tell me the means for it, great one."

গোবিন্দ কহয়ে—রাজা, না হও কাতর ।
এখানে না পাবে দেখা—হৈল অনবসর ॥ ৮৯ ॥

gobinda kahaẏe—rājā, nā hao kātara |
ekhāne nā pābe dekhā—haila anabasara || 89 ||

govinda kahaye — Govinda says; raja na hao katara — king, do not be distressed; ekhane na pabe dekha — you will not see [Him] here; haila anavasara — it is not the time

89Govinda says: "King, do not be distressed:
you will not see Him here — now is not the time."

কখন আসিব মুঞি কহ মহাভাগ ।
কাতর-বয়ান রাজা, বাঢ়ে অনুরাগ ॥ ৯০ ॥

kakhana āsiba muñi kaha mahābhāga |
kātara-baẏāna rājā, bāṛhe anurāga || 90 ||

kakhana asiba munyi — when shall I come; kaha mahabhaga — tell me, fortunate one; katara-bayana raja — the king speaks pleadingly; badhe anuraga — his love grows

90"When shall I come, tell me, fortunate one?" —
the king speaks pleadingly, and his love grows.

সেদিন রহিল রাজা সেই ত নগরে ।
সঙ্গিগণ দেখি' কাকু করয়ে সভারে ॥ ৯১ ॥

sedina rahila rājā sei ta nagare |
saṅgigaṇa dekhi' kāku karaẏe sabhāre || 91 ||

sedina rahila raja — that day the king stayed; sei ta nagare — in that town; sangigana dekhi — seeing [the Lord's] companions; kaku karaye sabhare — he implores them all

91That day the king stayed in that town
and, seeing [the Lord's] companions, implores them all.

পুরী-গোসাঞি আদি করি' যত ভক্তগণ ।
গোসাঞির গোচর করিবারে হৈল মন ॥ ৯২ ॥

purī-gosāñi ādi kari' yata bhaktagaṇa |
gosāñira gocara karibāre haila mana || 92 ||

puri-gosani adi kari — headed by Puri Gosani; yata bhaktagana — all the devotees; gosanira gochara karibare — to bring it to the Gosani's notice; haila mana — resolved

92All the devotees, headed by Puri Gosani,
resolved to bring this to the Gosani's notice.

এইমতে দিন দুই-চারি গেল যবে ।
কাশীমিশ্র-ঘরেতে একত্র হৈলা সভে ॥ ৯৩ ॥

eimate dina dui-cāri gela yabe |
kāśīmiśra-gharete ekatra hailā sabhe || 93 ||

eimate — thus; dina dui-chari gela yabe — when two or four days had passed; kashimishra-gharete — in the house of Kashi Mishra; ekatra haila sabhe — all gathered together

93When two or four days had passed thus,
they all gathered together in the house of Kashi Mishra.

সকল ভকত মেলি' যুকতি করিল ।
সভে মেলি' গোচরিব—এই যুক্তি কৈল ॥ ৯৪ ॥

sakala bhakata meli' yukati karila |
sabhe meli' gocariba—ei yukti kaila || 94 ||

sakala bhakata meli — all the devotees together; yukati karila — took counsel; sabhe meli gochariba — we shall tell [Him] all together; ei yukti kaila — so they resolved

94All the devotees took counsel together
and resolved: "We shall tell Him all together."

আর দিন মহাপ্রভু কাশীমিশ্র-ঘরে ।
আচম্বিতে সে আছে নিজ-ভক্ত-মেলে ॥ ৯৫ ॥

āra dina mahāprabhu kāśīmiśra-ghare |
ācambite se āche nija-bhakta-mele || 95 ||

ara dina — the next day; mahaprabhu kashimishra-ghare — Mahaprabhu at Kashi Mishra's house; achambite — as it happened; se achhe nija-bhakta-mele — He was among His devotees

95The next day Mahaprabhu, as it happened,
was in Kashi Mishra's house among His devotees.

রাজার ব্যগ্রতায় সভার কাতর অন্তর ।
পুরী-গোসাঞি কহিল সে প্রভুর গোচর ॥ ৯৬ ॥

rājāra byagratāẏa sabhāra kātara antara |
purī-gosāñi kahila se prabhura gocara || 96 ||

rajara vyagrataya — at the king's anxiety; sabhara katara antara — all were heavy at heart; puri-gosani kahila — Puri Gosani spoke; se prabhura gochara — before the Lord

96The king's anxiety weighed on all their hearts,
and Puri Gosani addressed the Lord:

এক নিবেদন গোসাঞি কহিতে ডরাঙ ।
নির্ভয়ে কহিয়ে তবে যদি আজ্ঞা পাঙ ॥ ৯৭ ॥

eka nibedana gosāñi kahite ḍarāṅa |
nirbhaẏe kahiẏe tabe yadi ājñā pāṅa || 97 ||

eka nivedana — one request; gosani — Gosani; kahite darana — I fear to tell; nirbhaye kahiye tabe — then I will speak without fear; yadi ajna pana — if I get permission

97"I have one request, Gosani, but fear to say it;
I will speak without fear if I have permission."

ঠাকুর কহয়ে—শুন পুরী-গোসাঞি ।
মোর ঠাঞি তোর ডর কোন কালে নাঞি ॥ ৯৮ ॥

ṭhākura kahaẏe—śuna purī-gosāñi |
mora ṭhāñi tora ḍara kona kāle nāñi || 98 ||

thakura kahaye — the Thakura says; shuna puri-gosani — listen, Puri Gosani; mora thanyi — before Me; tora dara kona kale nanyi — you need never have fear

98The Thakura says: "Listen, Puri Gosani:
before Me you need never be afraid.

কি কহিবে কহ, শুনি' হৃদয় তোমার ।
পুরী-গোসাঞি বোলে—বোল রাখিবে আমার ॥ ৯৯ ॥

ki kahibe kaha, śuni' hṛdaẏa tomāra |
purī-gosāñi bole—bola rākhibe āmāra || 99 ||

ki kahibe kaha — say what you would say; shuni hridaya tomara — I will hear your heart; puri-gosani bole — Puri Gosani says; bola rakhibe amara — will You grant my word

99Say what you would say — I will hear your heart."
Puri Gosani says: "Will You grant my request?

কাশীমিশ্র-আদি করি' যত ভক্তগণ ।
সভার বচনে মুঞি বলি এ বচন ॥ ১০০ ॥

kāśīmiśra-ādi kari' yata bhaktagaṇa |
sabhāra bacane muñi bali e bacana || 100 ||

kashimishra-adi kari — headed by Kashi Mishra; yata bhaktagana — all the devotees; sabhara vachane — on behalf of all; munyi bali e vachana — I say these words

100On behalf of all the devotees headed by Kashi Mishra
I say these words:

শ্রীজগন্নাথদেব নীলাচলে বাস ।
প্রতাপরুদ্র রাজা হয় তাঁর নিজ দাস ॥ ১০১ ॥

śrījagannāthadeba nīlācale bāsa |
pratāparudra rājā haẏa tāṁra nija dāsa || 101 ||

sri-jagannatha-deva — Sri Jagannatha-deva; nilachale vasa — dwells in Nilachala; prataparudra raja — King Prataparudra; haya tanra nija dasa — is His own servant

101Sri Jagannatha-deva dwells in Nilachala,
and King Prataparudra is His own servant.

তোর পদ দেখিবারে সাধে মো-সভারে ।
আজ্ঞা পাইলে হয় সেই চরণ-গোচরে ॥ ১০২ ॥

tora pada dekhibāre sādhe mo-sabhāre |
ājñā pāile haẏa sei caraṇa-gocare || 102 ||

tora pada dekhibare — to see Your feet; sadhe mo-sabhare — he entreats us all; ajna paile — if he gets permission; haya sei charana-gochare — he will come before those feet

102He entreats us all in order to see Your feet:
if he has permission, he will come before those feet."

প্রভু বোলে—সর্বজন, শুনহ বচন ।
সন্ন্যাসীর ধর্ম নহে রাজ-দরশন ॥ ১০৩ ॥

prabhu bole—sarbajana, śunaha bacana |
sannyāsīra dharma nahe rāja-daraśana || 103 ||

prabhu bole — the Lord says; sarvajana shunaha vachana — everyone, hear My word; sannyasira dharma nahe — it is not a sannyasi's dharma; raja-darashana — to see a king

103The Lord says: "Everyone, hear My word:
it is not a sannyasi's dharma to see a king.

আমি ত সন্ন্যাসী, সেই হয় মহারাজ ।
দোঁহার দর্শনে দোঁহার কিছু নাহি কাজ ॥ ১০৪ ॥

āmi ta sannyāsī, sei haẏa mahārāja |
doṁhāra darśane doṁhāra kichu nāhi kāja || 104 ||

ami ta sannyasi — I am a sannyasi; sei haya maharaja — he is a great king; donhara darshane — in the two meeting; donhara kichhu nahi kaja — neither has any purpose

104I am a sannyasi, and he is a great king:
neither of us has any purpose in meeting."

পুরী-গোসাঞি বোলে—প্রভু, কর অবধান ।
এ বোল শুনিলে রাজা হারিবে গেয়ান ॥ ১০৫ ॥

purī-gosāñi bole—prabhu, kara abadhāna |
e bola śunile rājā hāribe geẏāna || 105 ||

puri-gosani bole — Puri Gosani says; prabhu kara avadhana — Lord, hear me; e bola shunile — if he hears this; raja haribe geyana — the king will lose his senses

105Puri Gosani says: "Lord, hear me:
if the king hears this, he will lose his senses.

যে দেখিল আমরা তাহার অনুরাগ ।
এ কথা শুনিলে জীউ ছাড়িবে মহাভাগ ॥ ১০৬ ॥

ye dekhila āmarā tāhāra anurāga |
e kathā śunile jīu chāṛibe mahābhāga || 106 ||

ye dekhila amara — such as we have seen; tahara anuraga — his love; e katha shunile — if he hears this; jiu chhadibe mahabhaga — he will give up his life, O Glorious One

106We have seen what his love is like:
if he hears such words, he will give up his life, O Glorious One.

আজি ত হইল রাজার দশ উপবাস ।
সব ছাড়ি' পড়ি' আছে চরণ-প্রত্যাশ ॥ ১০৭ ॥

āji ta haila rājāra daśa upabāsa |
saba chāṛi' paṛi' āche caraṇa-pratyāśa || 107 ||

aji ta haila — today has come; rajara dasha upavasa — the king's tenth day of fasting; saba chhadi padi achhe — leaving all he lies [at the door]; charana-pratyasha — hoping for [Your] feet

107Today is already the king's tenth day of fasting:
leaving everything, he lies [at the door] in hope of [Your] feet."

কাতর হইয়া পুনঃ বোলে সর্বজন ।
রাজার ব্যগ্রতা দেখি' করিয়ে যতন ॥ ১০৮ ॥

kātara haiẏā punaḥ bole sarbajana |
rājāra byagratā dekhi' kariẏe yatana || 108 ||

katara haiya — pleadingly; punah bole sarvajana — all speak again; rajara vyagrata dekhi — seeing the king's anxiety; kariye yatana — we make this effort

108And again all say pleadingly:
"Seeing the king's anxiety, we are asking."

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু কহিছে বচন ।
আনহ রাজারে—মুঞি হইনু পরসন্ন ॥ ১০৯ ॥

e bola śuniẏā prabhu kahiche bacana |
ānaha rājāre—muñi hainu parasanna || 109 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu kahichhe vachana — the Lord speaks; anaha rajare — bring the king; munyi hainu parasanna — I am pleased

109Hearing this, the Lord says:
"Bring the king — I am pleased with him."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সভার ভেল উল্লাস ।
আনিল রাজারে—প্রভু করে পরকাশ ॥ ১১০ ॥

e bola śuniñā sabhāra bhela ullāsa |
ānila rājāre—prabhu kare parakāśa || 110 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; sabhara bhela ullasa — all rejoiced; anila rajare — they brought the king; prabhu kare parakasha — the Lord reveals [Himself]

110Hearing this, all rejoiced;
they brought the king — and the Lord reveals Himself.

প্রভুরে দেখিয়া রাজা পরণাম করে ।
প্রেমায় বিহ্বল রাজা আপনা পাশরে ॥ ১১১ ॥

prabhure dekhiẏā rājā paraṇāma kare |
premāẏa bihbala rājā āpanā pāśare || 111 ||

prabhure dekhiya — seeing the Lord; raja paranama kare — the king bows; premaya vihvala raja — the king, overwhelmed with prema; apana pashare — forgets himself

111Seeing the Lord, the king bows;
overwhelmed with prema, the king forgets himself.

পুলকে ভরিল অঙ্গ, ছল ছল আঁখি ।
প্রেমে গর গর ভেল গোরা-অঙ্গ দেখি' ॥ ১১২ ॥

pulake bharila aṅga, chala chala āṁkhi |
preme gara gara bhela gorā-aṅga dekhi' || 112 ||

pulake bharila anga — his body filled with thrills; chhala chhala ankhi — his eyes brimming; preme gara gara bhela — he was steeped in prema; gora-anga dekhi — seeing Gora's form

112His body filled with thrills, his eyes brimming;
seeing Gora, he was steeped in prema.

রাজারে দেখিয়া প্রভু লহু লহু হাস ।
ষড়ভুজ শরীর রাজা দেখে পরকাশ ॥ ১১৩ ॥

rājāre dekhiẏā prabhu lahu lahu hāsa |
ṣaṛabhuja śarīra rājā dekhe parakāśa || 113 ||

rajare dekhiya — seeing the king; prabhu lahu lahu hasa — the Lord smiles gently; shadbhuja sharira — a six-armed form; raja dekhe parakasha — the king sees revealed

113Seeing the king, the Lord smiles gently,
and the king sees the six-armed form [He] reveals12.

ষড়ভুজ দেখিয়া দণ্ড-পরণাম করে ।
টলমল করে অঙ্গ অনুরাগ-ভরে ॥ ১১৪ ॥

ṣaṛabhuja dekhiẏā daṇḍa-paraṇāma kare |
ṭalamala kare aṅga anurāga-bhare || 114 ||

shadbhuja dekhiya — seeing the Six-armed One; danda-paranama kare — he prostrates; talamala kare anga — his body sways; anuraga-bhare — under the weight of love

114Seeing the Six-armed One, he prostrates;
under the weight of love his body sways.

অবশ শরীর, নীর ঝরে দু-নয়নে ।
চৌদিগে হরিধ্বনি পরশে গগনে ॥ ১১৫ ॥

abaśa śarīra, nīra jhare du-naẏane |
caudige haridhbani paraśe gagane || 115 ||

avasha sharira — his body powerless; nira jhare du-nayane — tears stream from both eyes; chaudige haridhvani — all around the sound of Hari's name; parashe gagane — touches the sky

115His body is powerless, tears stream from both eyes;
all around, the name of Hari resounds, touching the sky.

ষড়ভুজ শরীর দেখি' শ্রীপ্রতাপরুদ্র ।
আনন্দে বিহ্বল, ভাসে প্রেমার সমুদ্র ॥ ১১৬ ॥

ṣaṛabhuja śarīra dekhi' śrīpratāparudra |
ānande bihbala, bhāse premāra samudra || 116 ||

shadbhuja sharira dekhi — seeing the six-armed form; sri-prataparudra — Sri Prataparudra; anande vihvala — overwhelmed with bliss; bhase premara samudra — floats in the ocean of prema

116Seeing the six-armed form, Sri Prataparudra,
overwhelmed with bliss, floats in the ocean of prema.

কণ্টকিত সব অঙ্গ আপাদ-মস্তকে ।
গদগদ ভাবে প্রভু প্রভু বলি' ডাকে ॥ ১১৭ ॥

kaṇṭakita saba aṅga āpāda-mastake |
gadagada bhābe prabhu prabhu bali' ḍāke || 117 ||

kantakita saba anga — his whole body bristling; apada-mastake — from head to foot; gadgada bhave — in a faltering voice; prabhu prabhu bali dake — he calls "Lord, Lord!"

117His whole body bristles from head to foot;
in a faltering voice he calls: "Lord, Lord!"

ঊর্ধ্ব বাহু করি' নাচে, বোলে হরিবোল ।
জনম সফল—প্রভু পরসন্ন মোর ॥ ১১৮ ॥

ūrdhba bāhu kari' nāce, bole haribola |
janama saphala—prabhu parasanna mora || 118 ||

urdhva bahu kari nache — raising his arms he dances; bole hari-bola — he cries "Hari-bol!"; janama saphala — my birth is fulfilled; prabhu parasanna mora — the Lord is pleased with me

118Raising his arms he dances and cries: "Hari-bol!
My life is fulfilled — the Lord is pleased with me!"

আনন্দে ভাসয়ে চৌদিগে ভক্তজন ।
প্রভু বোলে—রাজা, হের শুনহ বচন ॥ ১১৯ ॥

ānande bhāsaẏe caudige bhaktajana |
prabhu bole—rājā, hera śunaha bacana || 119 ||

anande bhasaye — float in bliss; chaudige bhaktajana — the devotees all around; prabhu bole — the Lord says; raja hera shunaha vachana — king, hear now My word

119The devotees all around float in bliss.
The Lord says: "King, hear My word:

প্রজার পালন তোর এই বড় ধর্ম ।
প্রজা পুত্র, রাজা পিতা—কহিল এ মর্ম ॥ ১২০ ॥

prajāra pālana tora ei baṛa dharma |
prajā putra, rājā pitā—kahila e marma || 120 ||

prajara palana — protecting the subjects; tora ei bada dharma — this is your great dharma; praja putra raja pita — the subjects are sons, the king is father; kahila e marma — I have told you its meaning

120to protect your subjects is your great dharma:
the subjects are sons, the king is father — such is the essence.

কৃষ্ণের কেবল দয়া সম সর্বজীবে ।
দেহের স্বভাব নিজ জানি অনুভবে ॥ ১২১ ॥

kṛṣṇera kebala daẏā sama sarbajībe |
dehera sbabhāba nija jāni anubhabe || 121 ||

krishnera kevala daya — Krishna's mercy alone; sama sarva-jive — is equal to all beings; dehera svabhava nija — the nature of one's own body; jani anubhave — knowing by experience

121Only Krishna's mercy is equal to all living beings;
know by experience the nature of your own body:

কিবা রাজা কিবা প্রজা সম সুখ-দুঃখ ।
কর্ম-অনুসারে জীব হয় গৌণ-মুখ্য ॥ ১২২ ॥

kibā rājā kibā prajā sama sukha-duḥkha |
karma-anusāre jība haẏa gauṇa-mukhya || 122 ||

kiba raja kiba praja — be it king or subject; sama sukha-duhkha — joy and sorrow are the same; karma-anusare — according to karma; jiva haya gauna-mukhya — a living being becomes lesser or greater

122be it king or subject, joy and sorrow are the same for all;
only by karma does a living being become lesser or greater.

নিজ-অনুমান করি' যে জানে সভারে ।
সেই সে কৃষ্ণের দাস—কহিল তোমারে ॥ ১২৩ ॥

nija-anumāna kari' ye jāne sabhāre |
sei se kṛṣṇera dāsa—kahila tomāre || 123 ||

nija-anumana kari — judging by himself; ye jane sabhare — who understands all others; sei se krishnera dasa — he indeed is Krishna's servant; kahila tomare — I tell you

123Whoever, judging by himself, understands all others —
he indeed is Krishna's servant, I tell you"13.

এতেক উত্তর প্রভু কৈল উপদেশ ।
পরণাম করে রাজা আনন্দ-বিশেষ ॥ ১২৪ ॥

eteka uttara prabhu kaila upadeśa |
paraṇāma kare rājā ānanda-biśeṣa || 124 ||

eteka uttara — such an answer; prabhu kaila upadesha — the Lord gave as instruction; paranama kare raja — the king bows; ananda-vishesha — in exceptional bliss

124Such an answer the Lord gave as instruction;
the king bows in exceptional bliss.

শুন সর্বজন গোরাচাঁদের প্রকাশ ।
আনন্দে কহয়ে গুণ এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১২৫ ॥

śuna sarbajana gorācāṁdera prakāśa |
ānande kahaẏe guṇa e locanadāsa || 125 ||

shuna sarvajana — hear, everyone; gorachandera prakasha — the manifestation of Gorachand; anande kahaye guna — joyfully tells [His] glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

125Hear, everyone, of Gorachand's manifestation;
joyfully this Lochana Dasa tells His glories.

✦

Notes

  1. Vv. 1–21 — cf. Murari 4.13 ("Mercy to the Cowherd"). In Lochana Dasa, as in Murari (4.14–4.15), the Lord goes from Vrindavana through Bengal (Kulia, Navadvipa, Shantipura) to Puri; according to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 16–18, 25), the Lord visited Kulia and Shantipura on the way to Vrindavana and returned from Vrindavana by way of Prayaga and Kashi.
  2. Vv. 9+1 — 9+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; they are absent in the 1903 edition. The end of v. 9+1 is unclear; translated by the sense.
  3. V. 13+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives it in a footnote as an additional reading of one printed edition.
  4. Vv. 22–69 — cf. Murari 4.14–4.15 (Kulia, the meeting with Shachi, Advaita's house, the return to Puri).
  5. "Vain" (michha) — cf. en/37, note 14. The Lord speaks as a sannyasi-teacher, addressing the whole world through His mother. Shachi's love itself is no worldly attachment: in the Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching Shachi is the Lord's eternal associate (Yashoda), and her motherly love (vatsalya-prema) is spiritual; Shachi herself answers that she knows this "maya of affection" of the Lord from the scriptures (v. 46), and the Lord admits that He is "captive to her virtues" (v. 53).
  6. "Maya" here is Shachi's motherly love, to which the Lord Himself submits (cf. v. 46).
  7. Vv. 53+1 — 53+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them in a footnote as an additional reading of a printed edition. The Lord reminds Shachi that she is His mother in many descents (as Kaushalya, Devaki and Yashoda, Aditi, Devahuti); in the Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching all avataras come from Krishna, who has appeared as Gaura.
  8. Cf. the Lord's farewell to Shachi in Murari (4.14).
  9. Vv. 70–125 — the mercy to Prataparudra; cf. Murari 4.16 (the king sees Gaura and Nityananda in kirtana and then, in dreams, as Krishna and Balarama).   11. The garden (tota) is the Lord's residence in Puri; Govinda is His servant; Puri Gosani (v. 92) is Paramananda Puri.   13. That is, whoever sees in others what he sees in himself — their joy and sorrow — is a true servant of Krishna.
